Author: Anna, beerpsi
Name: ExtraChatFork
Description:
ExtraChat adds end-to-end encrypted, cross-data-centre, unlimited linkshells
to the game. (Fork of official plugin with features and some fixes)
Changelog:
# Features
- /ecl is an extra alias for /ecl1.

# Fixes
- Fix the first line in a macro being sent to another chat instead of the ECLS.
- Fix received messages being garbled or out of order if they come in too fast.
